I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, which caps the loop at about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's limit of 5. The delay is a `CALL_DELAY_S` constant at the top of the file, so it's easy to adjust. I haven't run the test, so I haven't confirmed the flake is gone in CI.

I also saved the rate limit to EngramDB as a project memory, so future tests against the sandbox know to pace their calls.
